*nat
:PREROUTING ACCEPT [0:0]
:INPUT ACCEPT [0:0]
:OUTPUT ACCEPT [0:0]
:POSTROUTING ACCEPT [0:0]
:DOCKER - [0:0]
-A PREROUTING -m addrtype --dst-type LOCAL -j DOCKER
-A OUTPUT ! -d ::1/128 -m addrtype --dst-type LOCAL -j DOCKER
-A POSTROUTING -s fd00:dead::/64 ! -o br-ea606771aa10 -j MASQUERADE
-A DOCKER ! -s fe80::/10 ! -i br-ea606771aa10 -p tcp -m tcp --dport 8443 -j DNAT --to-destination [fd00:dead::2]:80
COMMIT
